lines.text: Reports have ended for this season. Traditionally weather and road conditions are reported on this page from November 1 to April 1. Should adverse weather occur that will impact travel, updates will be provided as information is available.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 22 to 34 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Gold Axe Camp
evidence.detail: left April 6; earlier seasons: May 4 (2023), April 24 (2024), April 28 (2025)

evidence.name: Moses Mtn
evidence.detail: left April 6; earlier seasons: May 16 (2023), May 6 (2024), May 10 (2025)

evidence.name: Sentinel Butte
evidence.detail: left April 4; earlier seasons: May 3 (2023), April 21 (2024), April 26 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at all 3 nearby stations.

evidence.name: Gold Axe Camp
evidence.detail: 0.8 in on April 3; earlier seasons: 13.8 in (2023), 6.0 in (2024), 11.4 in (2025)

evidence.name: Moses Mtn
evidence.detail: 1.4 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 22.5 in (2023), 10.2 in (2024), 19.4 in (2025)

evidence.name: Sentinel Butte
evidence.detail: 1.1 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 15.4 in (2023), 7.7 in (2024), 11.6 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between February 17 and April 17, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Gold Axe Camp
evidence.detail: melted out April 6, 1,072 ft above the pass; points to February 17 to April 17

evidence.name: Moses Mtn
evidence.detail: melted out April 6, 1,162 ft above the pass; points to February 14 to April 16

evidence.name: Sentinel Butte
evidence.detail: melted out April 4, 372 ft above the pass; points to March 4 to April 22
